title: Vfs Table Selectable Without Navigate
description: Virtual file system table must have selectable file nodes. In sketchpad, clicking a row directly navigates — this must not happen on click; selection only.
summary:
Fixed VFS double-click navigation not firing for home kits (Metabolism) and docs pages.

Root cause: @dnd-kit pointer listeners on draggable rows swallowed double-click; home kit rows were draggable despite canDrag:false on nodes.

- Table: route double-click via click detail>=2 before drag handlers; optional pointerActivationDelayMs (200ms on VFS) so dblclick wins over drag.
- Platform VFS: respect model canDrag; navigate via onNavigate or shell navigate command.
- Sketchpad: disable dragDrop on home VFS; home kit/docs navigateUri tests.
- E2E: home metabolism dblclick opens kit.

Tests: @semio-tech/ui-react 97 passed; sketchpad home vfs unit test passed.
